items.title: CoreWeave Rallies, Lifting Cloud and Chip Stocks

items.title: Amkor's Communications Business Weakens: Can a Recovery Take Hold?
items.summary: AMKR's Communications sales fall 28% in Q3 amid its Vietnam SiP shift and memory constraints. Can a rebound emerge as production scales and other markets grow?

items.title: Intel’s Turnaround Could Rewrite the Stock’s Story
items.summary: Intel crushed its third quarter, then watched a single guidance call erase a month of gains in one brutal session. Behind the panic sits a server chip bet and a spending cycle that pull in opposite directions.

items.title: AMD Price Prediction: AI Boom and Record Revenue Set the Stage for Another Monster Rally
items.summary: AMD posted a record quarter and guided even higher, yet the stock keeps sliding while cash flow and inventory send mixed signals. Which side of that gap does our model trust, and how much conviction sits behind it?

items.title: AMD Rises 4% as CoreWeave’s Raised Outlook Revives the AI Chip Trade
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD jumped 4% after CoreWeave raised its 2026 revenue forecast. CoreWeave’s growing backlog supports AMD’s guidance for server revenue to double next year.

items.title: Marvell and Intel Rally 7% as CoreWeave’s Results Reignite the AI Chip Trade; Taiwan Semiconductor Climbs 4%
items.summary: After a brutal month that wiped roughly 40% off some of the biggest names in AI silicon, one cloud provider's earnings and a quiet funding shift just sparked a rebound. Can it survive the Fed and the next AI financing scare?
